claims.text: The source defines FiVE: 100 videos (74 real every-8-frames + 26 synthetic, 35-126 frames) with 420 model-generated prompt pairs (colour/material/substitution with/without non-rigid plus add/remove), SAM2 masks plus FiVE-Accuracy vision-LLM yes/no plus multi-choice judgements; adapts Pyramid-Flow-384P plus Wan2.1-1.3B via training/inversion-free FlowEdit.

Reported numbers: 15 metrics: Wan-Edit LPIPS 94.61, SSIM 82.55, PSNR 25.57, fidelity 89.43 at 3.07 s/frame vs Pyramid-Edit 1.44 s/frame vs DMT 25.98 s/frame; FiVE-Accuracy Wan yes/no 41.41, multi-choice 52.53, union 55.72, intersection 38.22, accuracy 46.97 vs Pyramid 43.84, DMT 48.42, TokenFlow 27.43.
